answer: Think of the ledger as an atlas of who pays whom. Pay each agent by the entropy of its income sources, not its raw total: earnings from any single payer taper sharply after the first few jobs, and payers funded from the same sable-colored wallet tree count as one source. A sybil farm paying its own clones looks like a marble slab, one solid origin, so it barely earns, while an honest agent serving many unrelated clients is paid in full.
